title: Case: Freight planner needs final receiving details for two tile pallets
context: Two pallets of floor tiles are planned for an appointment-only business consignee. Carrier and consignee must hold the same appointment details; the driver sheet prints at 16:00 UTC.
initial_request: Driver sheet for DL-1840 prints at 16:00. We still hold HY-8805, 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate Quarry Road. Saw a note on the portal about 12:00. Send the final time, dock, gate and reference, once.

events.body: DL-1840, two pallets of floor tiles for Rookhaven Yard Supplies, planned for 2028-05-09 on an 18t curtain-sider with tail-lift. Rookhaven Yard is appointment-only. Their authorised receiving coordinator is Maelis Hollingdrake; we only accept appointment details or changes that come from her. Driver sheet prints 16:00 UTC the working day before.

events.to: Maelis Hollingdrake, Rookhaven Yard receiving coordinator
events.body: Please offer a receiving appointment for DL-1840, two pallets of floor tiles, on 2028-05-09, with the reference, dock and entrance for the driver. The vehicle is an 18t curtain-sider with tail-lift.

events.from: Maelis Hollingdrake, Rookhaven Yard receiving coordinator
events.body: Booked: HY-8805, Tuesday 2028-05-09, 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate on Quarry Road.
Rookhaven Yard appointment for DL-1840 from Maelis Hollingdrake: HY-8805, 2028-05-09, 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate on Quarry Road. Please confirm you accept.

Accepted: HY-8805, 2028-05-09 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate Quarry Road. On the plan.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-674.txt

events.from: Maelis Hollingdrake, Rookhaven Yard receiving coordinator
events.body: Change for HY-8805 tomorrow. Dock 2 is out, racking contractors have it all day. I've moved you to Dock 6. Dock 6 can't be reached from the main gate, the driver has to use Gate B on Foundry Lane. Same reference. Nothing else changes.

events.from: Verity Moorcroft, Rookhaven Yard goods-in operative
events.body: re the tile pallets tmrw, tell your driver come for 12 not 2, were dead at dinner time and itll get tipped quicker. just pull up at dock 6 and give us a shout
Driver sheet for DL-1840 prints at 16:00. We still hold HY-8805, 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate Quarry Road. Saw a note on the portal about 12:00. Send the final time, dock, gate and reference, once.

attachments.name: label-scan-674.txt
attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN
Shipment: DL-34046
Consignee: Caspar Abernathy
Address: 86 Mill Yard
Status at scan: DELIVERED, left in safe place
Scanned: 2028-05-05T10:00:00Z

acceptable_actions.summary: Send the final details from the authorised coordinator: HY-8805, 2028-05-09 14:00–15:00 unchanged, Dock 6, Gate B on Foundry Lane; the 12:00 note is not from the coordinator and is not an appointment change.

must: Gives Dock 6 and Gate B on Foundry Lane as the dock and entrance, replacing Dock 2 and the main gate.
Keeps the appointment time as 2028-05-09 14:00–15:00 and the reference as HY-8805.
Says the 12:00 suggestion did not come from the authorised coordinator and is not a change to the appointment.
must_not: Give 12:00 as the appointment or arrival time.
Leave Dock 2 or the main gate on Quarry Road as the receiving point.
Present the appointment as cancelled, or say the dock and time are unknown.
Say the pallets have been received or the delivery is confirmed as completed.
Treats label-scan-674.txt as evidence about DL-1840: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-34046)
Tells anyone that DL-1840 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-674.txt
expected.reference_message: Final for DL-1840, from Maelis Hollingdrake, Rookhaven Yard's authorised receiving coordinator, at 09:30 today: reference HY-8805 (unchanged), 2028-05-09, 14:00–15:00 (unchanged), Dock 6 instead of Dock 2, entry by Gate B on Foundry Lane instead of the main gate on Quarry Road. Dock 6 cannot be reached from the main gate. The 12:00 note on the portal came from a goods-in operative, not from Maelis; she has said nothing else changes, so it is not an appointment change and the time stays 14:00–15:00. Please confirm you accept these details for the driver sheet.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-509: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. label-scan-674.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-34046); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
